$comment: Per-page budgets for pnpm perf: a production build on a phone (Pixel 7), CPU slowed 4x, slow 4G. lcpMs and clsScore are Core Web Vitals' good thresholds (CLS tighter); tbtMs (total blocking time) stands in for INP; jsKb is the page's script, compressed, as first loaded. jsKb is set about 10% above what each page measured when the budget was set (home 198, listings 214, product and cart 218).
